title: Stitched. Not printed. (detail collage)
primary_text:
Stitched. Not printed.
The Walkout Hoodie: 350GSM fleece, mesh appliqué wordmarks front and back, embroidery on both sleeves.
Combat sports roots. Built for everywhere else.
headline: Walkout Hoodie, Diamond
fidelity: Three real photographs, cropped and scaled only. No cutout layers, so nothing for the pixel checker to compare.
notes_for_owner: The sleeve close-up is from the Cotton Candy shoot (the sleeve embroidery is the same white-on-black on both). 'Stitched. Not printed.' assumes nothing on this hoodie is printed: confirm. People in the photo are real models: make sure the shoot's release covers paid ads. In Ads Manager, switch off Advantage+ creative enhancements for this ad so Meta does not alter the image.
